title: Disappointed
text: I am not sure if I got a used box or something but the toys were not at all what I expected. I get their competitor box and was like why not try it. I was fairly disappointed in the quality of the toys. Usually my cats get all excited when the other box comes. They climb in and take all the toys out themselves. They wouldn’t even touch the box. I kept the box open on the floor for two days and they had no interest at all. My kitties for being 13 and 14 years old they are extremely active and love toys. I am not sure if it was a fluke or what but I was extremely disappointed.
label: negative
